features.feature: Sanitize path-like/code-like tokens (backticked spans, slash-segmented paths, hyphenated/dotted file-name tokens) out of the claimsShrinkage narrowingText scan before the trigger-word regex runs, so a DONE summary naming a file like core/partial-done-recovery.ts no longer triggers unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage
Sanitizer must not weaken genuine shrinkage detection: prose trigger words (including next to path tokens, or co-occurring with a path-name summary) must still trigger the gap

Repro-first regression test: add smoke case to proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.ts BEFORE the fix, record it RED against the unpatched heuristic, then GREEN after the fix; existing narrow-delivery positive control must keep failing the gate
Decide and document (keep/narrow/drop) whether bare trigger word remaining is too broad, with rationale, and implement + cover with a smoke assertion if narrowed

CHK-003 decision: NARROW remaining to require a co-occurring scope noun (work/scope/item(s)/case(s)/task(s)/milestone(s)/feature(s)/functionality/coverage/requirement(s)/deliverable(s)); bare remaining describing pre-existing/environment state (e.g. suite failures) no longer triggers, remaining <scope-noun> still triggers
Strict milestone-path DONE intent-equivalence logic and other DONE-gate checks are out of scope
